Index.meta_description: Create beautiful digital wedding invitations from just photos and event details. AI writes the text, picks a theme, and designs the layout.
Index.hero_badge: Create in minutes — no design skills needed
Index.hero_title: Beautiful wedding invitations, crafted by AI
Index.hero_subtitle: Upload your photos and event details. UndanganAI writes the words, chooses an elegant theme, and designs a shareable digital invitation — ready to send to your guests.
Index.how_title: Three steps to a stunning invitation
Index.how_subtitle: From photos to a polished invitation in minutes.
Index.how_step_1_desc: Add couple names, event dates, venues, and your favourite photos.
Index.how_step_2_desc: AI writes the opening words, picks a theme, and lays out every section.
Index.how_step_3_desc: Get a link to share. Guests RSVP and send wishes right from the invitation.
Index.sample_title: A sample of what you'll get
Index.sample_subtitle: Elegant, mobile-first, and ready to share.
Index.sample_quote: With gratitude, we invite you to celebrate the beginning of our life together.
Index.sample_venue: Akad Nikah — Saturday, 14 June 2026 · Grand Ballroom
Index.pricing_subtitle: Start free and pay only when you publish.
Index.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know before you start.
Index.faq_a1: No. You only provide photos and event details — the AI handles the writing, theme, and layout.
Index.faq_a2: Each invitation has a built-in RSVP form. Guests confirm their attendance and leave wishes without creating an account.
Index.faq_q3: Can I use my own photos?
Index.faq_a3: Yes. Upload a cover photo, couple portraits, and a gallery of up to 12 photos.
Index.faq_a4: Absolutely. Every invitation is designed mobile-first and opens instantly in the browser — no app required.
Index.faq_a5: Creating an invitation is free. You'll only pay a one-time fee when you're ready to publish and share it.
